name: liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass Card
blurb: Glassmorphic card with configurable blur, glow, and optional drag/expand.
description: A frosted-glass card with extensive styling options (blur intensity, shadow insets, glow effects, border radius). Optional draggable and expandable states via motion.
use_when: Modern glassmorphic UI designs, dashboards, or overlay cards where frosted-glass aesthetic and configurability matter.
avoid_when: Touch-only layouts where drag interactions may conflict with page scrolling, or where high blur intensity harms…
a11y: Card is a semantic container; children are independent. Drag is mouse-only; touch support is secondary. Blur effects may impact text readability.
